description_zh: 查询数据流动批量子任务
name: DescribeDataFlowSubTasks

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter key.

Valid values:

DataFlowIds: filters by data flow ID.
DataFlowTaskIds: filters by data flow task ID.
DataFlowSubTaskIds: filters by data flow streaming task ID.
Status: filters by data flow status.
SrcFilePath: filters by source file path.
DstFilePath: filters by destination file path
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的名称。

取值：

DataFlowIds: 根据DataFlow ID筛选。
DataFlowTaskIds：根据数据流动任务的ID筛选。
DataFlowSubTaskIds：根据数据流动流式任务的ID筛选。
Status：根据数据流动状态筛选。
SrcFilePath：根据源目标文件路径筛选。
DstFilePath：根据目标文件路径筛选
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter key. Wildcards are not supported for this parameter.

If Key is set to DataFlowIds, Value is set to a data flow ID or part of a data flow ID. You can specify one or more data flow IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow IDs can be specified. Example: `df-194433a5be31****` or `df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`.
If Key is set to DataFlowTaskIds, Value is set to a data flow task ID or part of a data flow task ID. You can specify one or more data flow task IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow task IDs can be specified. Example: `task-29ee8e890f45****` or `task-29ee8e890f45****,task-38ae8e890f45****`.
If Key is set to DataFlowSubTaskIds, Value is set to a data flow streaming task ID or part of a data flow streaming task ID. You can specify one or more data flow streaming task IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow streaming task IDs can be specified. Example: `subTaskId-370kyfmyknxcyzw****` or `subTaskId-247kyfmyknxcyzw****,subTaskId-256kyfmyknxcyzw****`.
If Key is set to Status, Value is set to the status of the data flow task, including EXPIRED, CREATED, RUNNING, COMPLETE, CANCELING, FAILED, and CANCELED. Combined queries are supported.
If Key is set to SrcFilePath, Value is set to the source file path. The maximum length is 1023 characters.
If Key is set to DstFilePath, Value is set to the destination file path. The maximum length is 1023 characters
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的值。该参数不支持通配符。

Key取值为DataFlowIds时，Value取值为数据流动ID或数据流动ID的一部分。可以是一个或一组DataFlowId，数据流动ID最多可设置10个。例如，`df-194433a5be31****`或`df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`。
当Key取值为DataFlowTaskIds时，Value取值为数据流动任务ID或数据流动任务ID的部分。可以是一个或一组数据流动任务ID，数据流动任务ID最多可设置10个。例如，`task-29ee8e890f45****`或`task-29ee8e890f45****,task-38ae8e890f45****`。
当Key取值为DataFlowSubTaskIds时，Value取值为数据流动流式任务ID或数据流动流式任务ID的部分。可以是一个或一组数据流动流式任务ID，数据流动流式任务ID最多可设置10个。例如，`subTaskId-370kyfmyknxcyzw****
`或`subTaskId-247kyfmyknxcyzw****,subTaskId-256kyfmyknxcyzw****`。
当Key取值为Status时，Value取值为数据流动任务的状态，包括EXPIRED、CREATED、RUNNING、COMPLETE、CANCELING、FAILED和CANCELED。支持组合查询。
当Key取值为SrcFilePath时，Value取值为源目标文件路径。最长为1023个字符。
当Key取值为DstFilePath时，Value取值为目标文件路径。最长为1023个字符

DataFlowSubTask.description_en: The collection of data flow streaming task information
DataFlowSubTask.description_zh: 数据流动流式任务信息合集

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the streaming task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 流式任务创建时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

DataFlowSubTaskId.description_en: The data flow streaming task ID

DstFilePath.description_en:
The destination file path.
Limits:
The length is 1 to 1023 characters.
UTF-8 encoding is used.
The path must start with a forward slash (/).
The path must end with a file name
DstFilePath.description_zh:
目标文件路径。
限制：
长度为 1~1023 个字符。
使用 UTF-8 编码。
必须以正斜线（/）开头。
必须以文件名称结尾

EndTime.description_en: The time when the streaming task ended. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
EndTime.description_zh: 流式任务结束时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

ErrorMsg.description_en:
The error message of the task execution failure.
If this field is not returned or is empty, no error occurred
ErrorMsg.description_zh:
任务执行失败消息。
当该字段未返回或者返回为空时，表示没有错误信息

Checksum.description_en: The file checksum. Format example: crc64:123456

ModifyTime.description_en: The file modification time as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: ns
ModifyTime.description_zh: 文件修改时间，unix时间戳。单位：ns

Progress.description_en: The execution progress of the data flow streaming task. Valid values: 0 to 10000
Progress.description_zh: 数据流动流式任务的执行进度。范围：0~10000

ProgressStats.description_en: The progress information of the data flow streaming task
ProgressStats.description_zh: 数据流动流式进度信息

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual data volume transferred. Unit: bytes

AverageSpeed.description_en: The average transfer speed. Unit: bytes/s

BytesDone.description_en: The data volume for which data flow has been completed, including skipped data. Unit: bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 已完成数据流动数据量（包括跳过数据）。单位：Byte

BytesTotal.description_en: The total data volume scanned at the source. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 源端扫描到数据量。单位：Byte

SrcFilePath.description_en:
The source file path.
Limits:
The length is 1 to 1023 characters.
UTF-8 encoding is used.
The path must start with a forward slash (/).
The path must end with a file name
SrcFilePath.description_zh:
源文件路径。
限制：
长度为 1~1023 个字符。
使用 UTF-8 编码。
必须以正斜线（/）开头。
必须以文件名称结尾

StartTime.description_en: The time when the streaming task started. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 流式任务开始执行时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Status.description_en:
The current status of the data flow streaming task. Valid values:

EXPIRED: The task has expired.
CREATED: The task has been created. 
RUNNING: The task is running.
COMPLETE: The task is complete.
CANCELING: The task is being canceled.
FAILED: The task has failed.
CANCELED: The task has been canceled
Status.description_zh:
当前数据流动流式任务状态。包括：

EXPIRED：任务已终止。
CREATED：任务已创建完成。 
RUNNING：任务正在运行中。
COMPLETE：任务已完成。
CANCELING：任务取消中。
FAILED：任务执行失败。
CANCELED：任务已取消
